summary: Tapping Add to cart sends a dot flying from the button to the bag, then the badge count bumps with an overshoot.
use: E-commerce add actions, saving to a list or any action whose result lives somewhere else on screen.
spec: `@keyframes cart-fly` moves the dot `translate(40px, -26px)` at 60% and `translate(72px, -4px)` at 100% while fading out
`setTimeout` of `520` ms after the click increments `count`, matching the flight length
`@keyframes cart-bump` scales the badge `1` to `1.5` and back
`announce(`Cart: ${count} items`)` tells assistive tech; the bag is `role="img"` with the count in its label
`{#key flight}` remounts the dot so each add flies again; nothing flies when reduced
